title: AgentModelConfig
description: Schema for .github/agents/model-config.json — defines approved models, tier mappings, and per-agent model assignments.

_comment.description: Human-readable comment; not processed by tooling.

approvedModels.description: List of model names approved for use in this organisation. Must be kept in sync with GitHub Settings → Copilot → Models.

tiers.description: Named tiers that map to concrete model strings. Each agent references a tier key rather than a model name directly.

name.description: Agent identifier; must match the basename of the corresponding {name}.agent.md file (without extension).

primary.description: Key of the tier (defined in 'tiers') to use as the primary model for this agent.

thinkingEffort.description: Optional thinking-effort hint written to agent frontmatter alongside the model.

notes.description: Free-text description of this agent's role. Not written to agent files.
